name: symcc-cursor
description: Run a team of coding agents from one chat: the symcc board and its lead, inside Cursor

commands.title: Set up symcc in this project

symcc.leadModel.description: The model the lead chat runs on (empty: symcc's default).

symcc.workerModel.description: The model for workers whose role names none (empty: symcc's default).

symcc.enginePath.description: The engine to run (empty: the one next to this extension, hosts/cursor/dist/engine.mjs).

symcc.nodePath.description: The Node.js to run the engine with (empty: the editor's own).

symcc.proxy.description: The proxy the engine reaches Cursor through, e.g. http://proxy.example.com:912 (empty: the editor's http.proxy setting, then HTTPS_PROXY).

symcc.notify.description: Show a notification when something new needs you while the board is not in view.
